decision: B-v1 remains historical development evidence. All future paired B/C development and reportable experiments use this neutral interface.

shared_inputs.candidate_and_context_requirement: B and C must use byte-identical frozen findings and contexts from the same source revision.

knowledge_slot.knowledge_id_rule: Only supplied chunk_id values may appear in knowledge_used. An empty supplied ID set permits only [].

invariance.only_permitted_difference: rendered retrieved_knowledge slot and the corresponding allowed knowledge ID set

failure_policy: A retrieval, rendering, model-identity, schema-binding, or provenance failure records error evidence and yields UNCERTAIN. It must not silently fall back from C to B.
limitations: This contract does not authorize a Variant C run or a benchmark result.
Development evidence must not be reported as held-out performance.
